company: AMSL Brevan Howard Asset Management Services Limited
title: Desktop Support Engineer
location: London
field: -
description:
# Tier 1: Portfolio Manager & Front Office Support (Priority Focus)
[under: Tier 1: Portfolio Manager & Front Office Support (Priority Focus)] Mandate: Be a trusted technology partner for portfolio managers and their pods, primarily in London, delivering white-glove support at the desk and remotely — and to the same standard for users in other hubs under the follow-the-sun model.
[under: Tier 1: Portfolio Manager & Front Office Support (Priority Focus)] - Serve as a primary technology partner for portfolio managers and front office users, with London as the primary focus, ensuring uninterrupted productivity and frictionless user experiences.
[under: Tier 1: Portfolio Manager & Front Office Support (Priority Focus)] - Deliver white-glove deskside and remote support to portfolio managers and their pod teams, resolving issues at speed and with zero tolerance for unresolved problems during trading hours.
[under: Tier 1: Portfolio Manager & Front Office Support (Priority Focus)] - Exercise absolute discretion when working with confidential trading and personnel information, and deal confidently and credibly with senior front office users.
[under: Tier 1: Portfolio Manager & Front Office Support (Priority Focus)] - Proactively manage the health and performance of PM workstations, multi-monitor trading setups, and all front office endpoints — eliminating issues before they arise.
[under: Tier 2: Global Desktop Support, Enterprise User Computing & Escalation] - Act as an escalation point for complex desktop and end-user computing issues, primarily for the London office and for other hubs as required under the follow-the-sun model, escalating onward to the Desktop Lead where needed and collaborating closely with core infrastructure, networking, and security teams to ensure end-to-end resolution.
[under: Tier 2: Global Desktop Support, Enterprise User Computing & Escalation] - Provide broader desktop and end-user support across the London office beyond the PM pod community, ensuring all users receive a consistently high standard of support.
[under: Tier 2: Global Desktop Support, Enterprise User Computing & Escalation] - Build trusted relationships with stakeholders across the London office, establishing the technology function as a credible, responsive, and high-quality presence within the business.
[under: Work Experience] - Minimum 3 years’ desktop support experience within a financial services or hedge fund environment, with a strong track record supporting front office or trading floor users.
[under: Work Experience] - Proven experience providing dedicated technology support directly to portfolio managers, traders, or equivalent senior front office stakeholders in a high-pressure trading environment.
[under: Technical Skills] - Proven trade floor and white-glove front office support experience, ideally within a hedge fund or investment bank.
[under: Technical Skills] - Expert-level support for Bloomberg terminals, Refinitiv/LSEG, and other front office market data and trading platforms.
[under: Technical Skills] - Experience supporting OMS, EMS, and other trading-critical front office applications.
# Confidence with Senior Front Office Stakeholders
[under: Confidence with Senior Front Office Stakeholders] Deals with senior front office users, including portfolio managers, with genuine confidence and professionalism.
[under: Confidence with Senior Front Office Stakeholders] Adapts naturally to the formality and discretion each situation demands.both office and residential settings, without being overawed or under-prepared.
# Front Office Discretion & Professionalism
